notes: garden-vue is the app repo, not a design-system component package (no library build, no Storybook), so nothing is generated from a library target. The sync uploads Tailwind design tokens (colors/fonts) as styles.css, brand images from public/, and hand-authored component preview pages. Each preview needs a first-line <!-- @dsCard group="..." --> marker or it contributes no card and the Design System pane reports the project empty; _ds_manifest.json is recompiled app-side after upload, not by the push.
